newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daimler-Benz says in talks with Ssangyong.
newsitem.headline: Daimler-Benz says in talks with Ssangyong.

text.p: Daimler-Benz AG said on Thursday it was negotiating with the Ssangyong Group on increasing its stake in the group's troubled carmaking unit, Ssangyong Motor.
"We are now discussing the issue with Ssangyong. But the result will, we expect, come out at around the end of August or early in September," said company spokesman May Dedles.
Daimler-Benz currently has a 2.55 percent stake in Ssangyong.
Dedles said the two companies were discussing many different possibilities as his company was interested in the rapidly growing Asian market.
"We are tapping various business possibilities with Ssangyong because we are interested in what is going on in the fast-growing Asian market," he told Reuters from his German office.
But he said he could not elaborate on the ongoing talks.
Earlier in the day, a Ssangyong Group spokesman said Ssangyong was in talks with Daimler-Benz, but denied a news report that a tentative agreement had been reached.
